statute: TX TRANS CODE §545.060 / TX DRIVER HANDBOOK CH. 6
prompt: During a lane change, why is a physical over-the-shoulder chin-to-shoulder head check mandatory?

options.text: To verify vehicles or motorcycles hidden in mirror blind spots before moving
To stretch neck vertebrae and relieve physiological highway fatigue
To ensure rear-seat passengers have secured their lap safety belt buckles
To verify that the vehicle's rear turn signal bulb is actively flashing
